title: Quentin and the Provision
author: Wren Dunmore
blurb: Cyrus Oyelaran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
